bandLines: WE CAME UP FOR DA LOOT. SO FAR DA FLOOR HAB TAKEN MORE DEN IT HAB GIVEN!
KEEP TA DA WALLS. WHATEVER NESTS HERE DOES NO HEAR STONE!
LOST ONE OF OURS TWO FLOORS DOWN. WE IZ NO TURNIN' BACK FOR DA BODY!
IF YOU FIND DA STAIR BEFORE WE DO, LEAVE DA DOOR OPEN BEHIND YOU!
THREE OF US WENT IN. COUNT US ON YA WAY OUT AN' SEE HOW MANY DERE IZ!
DA LIFT ANSWERS, BUT NO ALWAYS TA DA FLOOR YOU ASKED IT FOR!
WE HUNT WHAT DA TOWER FEEDS. DO NO GET BETWEEN US AN' IT!
REST IF YOU LIKE. NOTHIN' UP HERE RESTS WIT YOU!
EVERY FLOOR IZ SOMEBODY'S LAST ONE. TRY NO TA MAKE IT DIS ONE!
YOU CLIMB FOR DA TOP, WE CLIMB FOR DA PAY. SAME STAIRS!

worldKindBlurb.mixed: A WORLD DAT TOOK IN WHOEVER DA SHAFT SENT IT, AN' MADE A PEOPLE OUT OF DA MIXTURE!
worldKindBlurb.earthling: EARTH PEOPLE WHO CLIMBED IN AN' NEVER CLIMBED BACK OUT. DEY STILL KEEP EARTH'S CALENDAR!
worldKindBlurb.goblin: GOBLINS ALL DA WAY DOWN, LOUD ABOUT IT, AN' ORGANISED INTO SOMETHIN' DEY INSIST IZ A GOVERNMENT!
worldKindBlurb.monster: NOTHIN' HERE WAZ EVER TAME, AN' WHAT RULES IT RULES BY BEING DA LARGEST THING IN DA ROOM!
worldKindBlurb.beast: ANIMALS, AN' DA WEATHER DAT MOVES DEM. NOTHIN' HERE BUILDS OR BELIEVES ANYTHIN'!
worldKindBlurb.zombie: DA PLAGUE RAN ITS COURSE AN' DA POPULATION STAYED ON AFTERWARDS!
worldKindBlurb.fungoid: ONE ORGANISM WEARIN' A GREAT MANY BODIES, AN' DISAGREEIN' WIT ITSELF IN ALL OF DEM!
worldKindBlurb.machine: DA PEOPLE DIED AN' DA INSTITUTIONS DID NO. DA ELECTIONS IZ STILL HELD ON SCHEDULE!
worldKindBlurb.alien: NOTHIN' ON EARTH APPLIES HERE, AN' ITS PEOPLE IZ UNBOTHERED BY DAT!
worldKindBlurb.magical: MAGIC WAZ NEVER BOUND HERE, SO EVERY TRADE IZ A SCHOOL AN' EVERY SCHOOL IZ A FACTION!
worldKindBlurb.undead: A WORLD DAT KEPT ITS DEAD IN OFFICE!
worldKindBlurb.mutant: A WORLD DAT CHANGED FASTER DEN IT COULD AGREE ON WHAT IT WAZ!
worldKindBlurb.severed: MAGIC DOES NO REACH HERE. WHAT IZ LEFT IZ MACHINERY, PAPERWORK AN' PATIENCE!
worldKindBlurb.ruin: WHATEVER LIVED HERE FINISHED, AN' DA BUILDINGS HAB NO BEEN TOLD!
worldKindBlurb.mimic: EVERYTHIN' IZ FURNITURE UNTIL IT IZ NO!

world.heading: WORLD
world.earthSeat: KEEPS EARTH'S OWN NATIONS AN' HYPERPOWERS!
world.offworld: OFFWORLD. NO PLACE ON DA WORLD MAP ANSWERS FOR IT!
